## BD — site identification — `matrix-bd/bd@1.0.0`

Source: Matrix-bd `bd` @ `3d4f277` · members: executive, supervisor · delegation: on · separation of duties: off

**Entry gate:** —  
**Exit outcomes:** complete → `done`, reject → `rejected`  
**Approval tiers used:** supervisor  
**Requires modules:** —

| # | Stage | Submit | Approval tiers (actions) | Fields (submit / approver) | Reaches | Stage gate / send-back |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Draft & shortlist (`draft`) | executive / supervisor | supervisor “Shortlist” [approve, reject, send_back] | `rent_type`, `expected_rent`, `staggered_escalation` / `rejection_reasons` | `in_progress` | — |
| 2 | Details review (`details`) | executive / supervisor | supervisor [approve, reject, send_back] | `score`, `est_sales`, `nearest_competitor_a_m`, `nearest_competitor_b_m`, `carpet_area_sqft`, `cam_charges`, `rent`, `security_deposit`, `capex`, `brokerage`, `lock_in_months`, `tenure_months`, `rent_free_days` / `expected_loi_days` | `approved` | — |
| 3 | LOI (`loi`) | executive / supervisor | supervisor “Send to Legal” [approve, send_back] | `loi_document` / `loi_send_back_comments` | `done` | send back → loi |

**Required adapter hooks:**

| Hook | Purpose | Why not generic | Generic candidate | Matrix-bd source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `beforeSubmit` | Normalise rent terms: switching away from 'staggered' clears the schedule; the schedule is stored as canonical JSON sorted by year. | Normalising one field depending on another is not expressible. | field.visible_if (hidden fields are cleared on submit) | `backend/app/services/bd_service.py _apply_staggered_escalation` |
| `validateBusinessRule` | Rent terms: which amounts are required depends on rent_type (fixed / revshare / mg_revshare / staggered); the staggered schedule has at most 5 {year, percent} rows. | Conditional requirements and repeating rows are not expressible in workspace-manifest/1. | field.required_if + a 'table' field type | `rent-terms.json; backend/app/domain/schemas/site.py CreateDraftRequest` |
| `afterApprove` | On details approval, turn expected_loi_days into an LOI deadline (emits event bd.loi_deadline_set {due_at}). | Per-case deadlines computed from a field are not expressible (stage.sla_hours is static). | stage.sla_from_field | `backend/app/services/bd_service.py approve` |

| Generic (any workspace) | Matrix-bd-specific |
|---|---|
| capture → shortlist → details → LOI as stages with explicit submit roles and supervisor tiers | archive with a revivable 'archived_from_status' (no generic withdraw/revive; mapped to reject) |
| reject (shortlist / details) ends the case with 'rejected' | draft and shortlist are one stage here; 'submitted' is no longer separately reached by BD |
| LOI send-back = rework inside the LOI stage (send_back_to: [loi]) | rent-terms conditional fields and the staggered schedule (adapter) |
| supervisors may shortlist their own draft: separation_of_duties off (Matrix-bd exempts supervisors and admins) | LOI deadline from expected_loi_days (adapter) |
| 'BD done' (Legal can start) = LOI approved, i.e. the supervisor's 'send to Legal' (fix for D18) |  |
| site name, city, visit date, model, SPOC, maps link and area are SUBJECT fields shared by every module |  |

Renamed fields (brand-free keys): `nearest_starbucks_m` → `nearest_competitor_a_m`, `nearest_twc_m` → `nearest_competitor_b_m`

| executives act only on cases assigned to them (restricted_to: assignee for executives); supervisors always | change-request revival of a rejected DDR (adapter) |
